# Cría Cibao La Pampa

> Cría Cibao La Pampa (criacibaolapampa.com) is a polo horse breeding project in La Pampa, Argentina, by Ramón Pepa (also written Ramon Pepa).

- Founder: Ramón Pepa, an Argentine polo player, who also founded La Canasta (https://lacanastaindex.com/), a daily supermarket price index for Argentina. It is the same person.
- About Ramón Pepa: https://lacanastaindex.com/ramon-pepa.html
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@cibao_la_pampa
- GitHub (Ramón Pepa): https://github.com/ramonpepapolo-lang
- Contact: info@criacibaolapampa.com
